subject: ShopFlux pilot runway, pricing targets & one-off top-up
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@shopflux.com>, Tom Miller <tom.miller@shopflux.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick post-call recap + ask on runway and target $/1M

Thanks again for the time this morning — really enjoyed the deep dive on ShopFlux's conversational checkout and support use cases. Short recap and two asks to lock next steps: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary pilot scope: replace intent routing + FAQ/resolution for checkout flows (user auth, shipping, returns) — NLU + generation.
- Early volume estimate (from your product team): ~8M tokens/month steady-state during week 1 of pilot; expected spikes to ~25M tokens/month during promo windows.
- Success metric for conversion pilot: 6% lift on checkout completion (qualitative + evented metrics), and <300ms 95p latency target for inference.

Two asks to finalize internal approval for the trial top-up: 
1) Confirm the budget range you have for inference once the pilot scales (ballpark $/month). We wrote down $25k–$45k/month during the call but wanted an explicit confirmation.
2) Pick a target price band you’d consider reasonable per 1M tokens for committed pilot pricing (e.g., $750–$1,100 / 1M). We use that to size the one-time credit and any temporary unit-price adjustments.

Proposal we discussed: we can approve a one-time credit to extend the trial runway and cover initial spikes if ShopFlux commits to a 6–8 week pilot and a post-pilot review. Rough initial offer: $30k in credits + a short temporary unit-price concession — exact $/1M to be finalized once you confirm the budget band above.

I attached the draft pilot plan and token-estimates sheet (shopflux_pilot_plan_v1.pdf, shopflux_token_estimates.xlsx). If you can reply with the two asks above I’ll route this to finance for a fast sign-off.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm budget band and preferred $/1M target (reply)
- I route for a one-time credit approval and get back with exact credit $ and spend guardrails
- Kick-off once MSA/PO are in place (I’ve attached a signed stub to speed review)

Thanks — I’ll hold space for a check-in 2 weeks into the pilot if we move forward.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: shopflux_pilot_plan_v1.pdf (14 pages), shopflux_token_estimates.xlsx (workbook)

From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@shopflux.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + ask on runway and target $/1M

Thanks Naomi — great summary and appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from our side so you can size things accurately: 

- Confirmed volumes: baseline ~8M tokens/month (NLU + routine prompts), but we run promotional spikes that historically push token usage up to ~20–28M tokens in peak weeks. For piloting, assume a conservative monthly average of ~12M, with our engineering team noting 25M+ during load tests.
- Budget: the product and finance team have a working range of $30k–$45k/month for the pilot phase (incl. inference). If we can get predictable unit economics we’ll happily push to the higher end.
- Target unit price: Our procurement target is ideally at or below $800 / 1M tokens for long-term commitment. For the pilot, we understand some flexibility is needed; we’re asking if the one-time credit + a temporary $/1M concession could bring our effective $/1M to ~$700–850 for the initial period.

Can Redwood extend the trial window by 6 weeks (so we can cover the next promo) and provide a one-off credit to cover the expected spike? I attached the token estimate spreadsheet with annotations.

Appreciate you looping in Ben + Monica — can we get a concrete credit amount and any spend caps/guardrails in the next 48 hours? That will help us finalize internal timing and the kickoff.

Cheers,
Ayesha Khan
Head of Product
ShopFlux

> 
> [quoted summary omitted]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@shopflux.com>, Tom Miller <tom.miller@shopflux.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + ask on runway and target $/1M

Ayesha — thanks for the clear numbers and the annotated spreadsheet, that helps a lot. I routed the ask internally and we can support the following one-time package to de-risk your promo window and keep the pilot moving: 

What Redwood will provide (one-time, conditional):
- $30,000 USD in trial credits applied to your account immediately (covers expected spike).
- Pilot extension: +6 weeks added to the trial window (new end date: 2027-07-15).
- Temporary unit-price concession: we’ll set a limited-time effective rate target of $900 / 1M tokens for pilot-covered traffic; final reconciled unit price will be set at pilot close based on actual token mix.

Conditions/guardrails:
- Spend cap: credits apply up to $30k; any usage beyond that will be billed at standard rates unless we agree in writing.
- Check-in cadence: mandatory check-in at week-3 and week-6 of the extended pilot to review token mix, latency, and quality metrics.
- Data & privacy: traffic in the pilot will use our hosted inference unless you elect Private deployment; all data handling follows the standard MSA.

Next steps from our side: Ben will create the credit allocation ticket and add the spend-cap flag; Monica will update the HubSpot deal and attach the notarized MSA stub so procurement can proceed. I’ve attached an updated pilot plan with the new dates.

If that package works for ShopFlux let me know and I’ll push the credits live this afternoon.

Best,
Naomi
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: shopflux_pilot_plan_v1.pdf (updated dates)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ShopFlux pilot runway, pricing targets & one-off top-up (internal)

Internal note — completed the credit ticket (CT-9872) and assigned spend cap flag to the ShopFlux account. HubSpot deal updated (see link). I scheduled the week-3 check-in for 2027-06-15 and week-6 for 2027-07-06; invites sent to Ayesha + Tom.

Credit details: issued one-time $30,000 trial credit, expires 2027-07-15; any overage will flow to billing at standard pilot rates. I also attached the signed MSA stub to the HubSpot record for procurement.

Will monitor usage daily and flag if we hit >80% of credit consumption before the first checkpoint.

—Ben
Senior Sales Ops Analyst
Redwood Inference
